vehicles.$comment: Delivery-vehicle sprites for the scripted 'protect the delivery' beat. Single source of truth for scripts/gen-vehicle-sprites.mjs. Side-profile (they roll horizontally down the street lane), house style: pure photocopied fanzine B&W (the neon rim is render-side per ADR 0011, no longer baked into the sprite; the `neon` name below is render metadata), generated on flat pure-black then chroma-keyed to transparent (same detour as scripts/cutout-enemies.mjs). vehicleType ('truck'|'car'|'moto') is the shared cross-lane key: gameplay picks it per delivery, the renderer loads `asset` below. Contract: files live at public/assets/vehicles/{truck,car,moto}.png. Real FLUX art is generated in CI (network); committed PNGs may be procedural placeholders until regenerated with FORCE=1.

enemies.$comment: Enemy sprite flipbook frames (Prohibition-1987-style 2-frame flips). Single source of truth for scripts/gen-enemy-types.mjs. Keys are the exact base filename (asset root + legacy variant suffix) that fileFor() in src/render/scene/enemyTextures.ts computes: enemy_sprite_2 = normal cop VARIANT 2. frames[0] is ALWAYS '' (the committed unsuffixed PNG is frame 1 and is never regenerated); frames[i>0] is a short pose-delta clause for the extra frame file <key>_f<i+1>.png (keys already carry the enemy_ prefix), generated in CI via kontext img2img from the committed frame 1 (fallback: matched pair under the pinned seed). Only the pose clause varies between frames; `style` is appended verbatim to every prompt. fps drives the render-side flipbook (src/render/scene/flipbook.ts).

courier.$comment: Street-courier (livreur) LAYERED flipbook: BIKE (wheel rotation) drawn under RIDER (pedaling cycle), composited as two stacked planes in src/render/scene/CourierSprite.tsx. Single source of truth for scripts/gen-courier-sprites.mjs. STRIP-AND-SLICE (ADR 0016): one FLUX image per layer — a horizontal strip of frames.length identical square cells (strip width = size.width * frames.length, always derived, never stored) — sliced into per-frame PNGs on a fixed grid and chroma-keyed per file (cutout-enemies.mjs cutout()). UNLIKE enemies, every frames[i] is a NON-EMPTY pose clause (cell i+1 of the strip); there is no protected committed frame 1 — if ANY frame file of a layer is missing, the WHOLE strip regenerates (frames from two generations are not the same character, so the layer is atomic). Files: public/assets/courier/<layer>.png + <layer>_f<N>.png (frame 1 unsuffixed). scale/offsetY are render-side registration knobs (relative to the courier plane, world units) tuned at the art gate; z-order (bike under rider) is fixed in code. The rider layer is described POSITIVELY as a figure in riding posture (art bible §3: never negate — never write 'without bike').
